acceptance.given: An aggregate execution has an applicable time bound and its execution record is available.

oracle.expected: The aggregate execution record shows a bounded terminal completion with elapsed time at or below the applicable bound.
forbidden: An aggregate exceeds its time bound.
An aggregate remains active without a bounded terminal outcome.
oracle.observable: Aggregate execution record containing terminal state and elapsed-time comparison against the applicable bound.

acceptance.then: The verification records a terminal outcome and confirms elapsed time is within the applicable bound.
acceptance.when: Run aggregate verification and inspect its recorded terminal state and elapsed-time measurement.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select an aggregate execution whose elapsed time exceeds its applicable bound or lacks a bounded terminal state.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure aggregate verification records a deterministic terminal state and rejects executions exceeding the applicable time bound.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing aggregate result and timeout fields; rollback restores prior bounded-execution checks.

slice_hint.state_transition: Aggregate executing with bound -> terminal success only when elapsed time is within bound; timeout or unbounded execution -> unsuccessful terminal state.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Aggregate record has a terminal state, elapsed_time <= applicable_bound, and no active execution remains.

acceptance.given: Declared evidence boundaries and frozen historical artifacts are available before a repair operation.

oracle.expected: Repair evidence is appended within declared boundaries while frozen historical membership, paths, and bytes remain unchanged.
forbidden: Repair evidence overwrites, deletes, or writes outside the declared boundaries.
oracle.observable: Post-repair artifact comparison showing unchanged historical artifacts and appended repair evidence confined to declared paths.

acceptance.then: Artifact comparison confirms only in-boundary append operations occurred and historical content is byte-identical.
acceptance.when: Execute repair evidence capture, then compare the declared historical artifact manifest and write set with the post-operation state.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a repair capture that overwrites, deletes, or writes evidence outside declared boundaries.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Append repair evidence only within declared evidence boundaries and preserve frozen historical artifacts byte-for-byte.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No schema migration; rollback removes only newly appended repair evidence while restoring prior historical artifacts.

slice_hint.state_transition: Declared historical artifacts intact -> append in-boundary repair evidence -> historical membership, paths, and bytes remain unchanged.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation reports unchanged frozen historical artifact membership, paths, and bytes and all new evidence paths are within declared boundaries.

acceptance.given: A matrix aggregate summary is being computed and matrix evidence has not executed.

oracle.expected: The aggregate summary is marked invalid when matrix evidence is not executed.
forbidden: The summary is marked valid while matrix evidence is unexecuted.
oracle.observable: Summary artifact status is invalid with a reason identifying non-executed matrix evidence.

acceptance.then: The matrix summary artifact records invalid status and prevents valid aggregate publication.
acceptance.when: Run matrix summary validation against evidence marked non-executed and inspect the resulting summary artifact.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a matrix summary generated from unexecuted evidence that is incorrectly marked valid.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Invalidate aggregate summaries whenever matrix evidence is missing, copied, mislabeled, stale, wrong-target, infrastructure-failed, or non-executed.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing summary status and invalidation reason fields; rollback restores prior validation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix evidence unexecuted -> summary invalid; only executed valid evidence may produce a valid aggregate summary.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Summary artifact status is invalid and contains a non-executed-evidence reason; no valid aggregate is emitted.

acceptance.given: The three named evaluation-seed occurrences are recorded for inspection.

oracle.expected: Each named evaluation-seed occurrence has applicability recorded alongside its provenance and classification fields.
forbidden: A named evaluation-seed occurrence lacks applicability information.
oracle.observable: Evaluation-seed manifest contains exactly three named occurrences and each occurrence has a non-empty applicability field.

acceptance.then: Manifest validation confirms applicability is present for every named occurrence.
acceptance.when: Validate the evaluation-seed manifest and inspect all three named occurrence records.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select an evaluation-seed manifest occurrence with a missing or empty applicability field.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require applicability metadata for each of the three named evaluation-seed occurrences and reject incomplete manifests.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve manifest schema compatibility while enforcing applicability validation.

slice_hint.state_transition: Occurrence records without applicability -> validation failure; records with applicability for all three -> accepted manifest.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validator accepts only when exactly three named occurrences exist and each has non-empty applicability.
